capabilities: Rename pasted and drag-dropped images via template before the link is inserted
Build filenames from date, time, counter, original name, note name, and frontmatter variables
Batch-organize image names in the current note or the whole vault
Find and clean up unreferenced images
Set per-note image folders and counters through frontmatter keys
disambiguation: Only renames image attachments (pasted, dropped, or in notes), not note files.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; UI is available in English and Chinese.
problem: Obsidian pastes images under default timestamped names, so attachments accumulate with meaningless filenames that are hard to organize.
summary: Renames pasted and dropped images using templates with dates, counters, note names, and frontmatter variables.
